text:
devon: Heads-up — KestrelLabs wants a short early-access sandbox for their new NPU boards next month. They asked for a gated lab window + press embargo. Can we sketch the gating + bench plan?

sarah: Nice, who's on the Kestrel side? NDA already signed? :eyes:

devon: Contact is @anders_k (Kestrel). NDA is half-signed, legal asked for our redlines yesterday. maria is looped on the contract.

maria: I asked legal to expedite. We need to confirm the embargo window and whether press gets a separate approval flow. Also need to verify their sample data rules.

liam: From infra: we can carve a sandbox pool (2xA100 equiv) for a 2-week soak. What's the expected perf targets?

devon: Kestrel's ask: throughput numbers for 8k seq, end-to-end latency p50/p95, and a small regen test under batch 8. Also a quick inference/quant profiling run. They want a short public bench excerpt under embargo.

eva: For telemetry, do we have their telemetry schema? We need to make sure no PII leaves their lab. partner_ops_bot: Reminder: please attach telemetry-data-handling checklist before next sync.

maria: Anders sent a JSON schema and a scrubbed sample. I'll drop it in the drive.

liam: Ops notes: sandbox will live in us-west-2, dedicated subnet, locked to Kestrel IPs and our VPN. We'll enable ephemeral log exports to an S3 bucket with restricted access. QA will need an allowlist for IPs + API keys.

sarah: Can we avoid full model weights transfer? Prefer they bring tests that call the model via our runtime, or we run the model in their lab and only run inference traces here.

devon: Kestrel prefers bringing their hardware to our lab for runs so we can profile kernels. They may hand over a small model artifact under NDA. Legal ok?

maria: Legal flagged model artifact transfer as "sensitive" but allowed if encrypted in transit and a destruction clause is included. I'll add that.

liam: Bench plan draft (very high level):
```
- 2 warmup runs (8k seq)
- steady-state throughput (10k tokens/sec target) for 5 min windows
- latency distribution: p50/p90/p95 for short and long prompts
- memory/thermal telemetry collection (1s granularity)
- quantization sanity checks: compare fp16 baseline to 8-bit run
```

liam: We should also capture kernel-level stalls and IO waits; I'll include `nvidia-smi dmon` + perf counters.

devon: Great. Who will be the single point for tech liaison during the run? Anders asked for a named engineer.

eva: I can be on-day liaison for infra and telemetry. liam can cover profiling. devon will be partner lead.

maria: Action items: legal finalizes NDA redlines by Wed, infra to provision sandbox by Fri, bench harness + scripts by Tue next week, press embargo window draft by Thu.

sarah: About press: we shouldn't commit to any quotes until we agree on embargo duration and whether Kestrel or Redwood drafts the joint announcement. Suggest 14-day embargo post-run.

anders_k (Kestrel): Anders here — thanks for the quick sync. 14 days works. We'll provide a sanitized bench summary for your review. We cannot share raw telemetry outside the NDA.

devon: Noted. We'll only publish high-level numbers and a short methodology blurb. Any logos or joint materials need both legal approvals.

liam: Quick technical ask — what's the expected batch distribution? uniform 8 or mixed? That affects kernel choices.

anders_k (Kestrel): Mostly mixed: 1-8 batch sizes, spikes to 16. We'll send a representative load file.

eva: OK, send load file to the drive folder. We'll run a replay harness. Also tagging @partner_ops_bot to create a run reservation.

partner_ops_bot: Run reservation created: sandbox-kestrel-1756, window 2025-03-18 to 2025-03-31, owners: devon, eva, liam.

maria: I've uploaded the NDA draft with the artifact-transfer clause. Please review comments by EOD Wed.

sarah: One more: marketing wants to prep a joint blog template but will hold until legal says go. I'll loop them after NDA sign-off.

devon: Cool. Let's keep this tight. Short sync next Tue to confirm infra & bench scripts. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

maria: FYI — if legal pushes a visibility restriction we may need to redact kernel-level traces from any shared docs.

liam: Noted. We'll keep raw perf traces internal and provide aggregated metrics for the public excerpt.

anders_k (Kestrel): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll send the load file and sanitized sample today.

sarah: Ping if anything changes.

partner_ops_bot: Reminder: infra provisioning ETA set to 2025-03-14 18:00 UTC.

devon: End of thread — recording action items into Asana now.
